tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get how to reach Danny Keane: email, LinkedIn, Twitter, GitHub, Figma and his investing firm, one channel per line, then his San Francisco local time and usual reply time. Pass channel for one of them. Returns plain text. It only shows the channels; it sends no message.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: get_profile_page, get_contact · Public sink: get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: get_profile_page, get_contact · Public sink: get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
